# superset_dashboard_copy (Resource)

Manages a dashboard copied from another one, for example a dashboard per region made from a template. The copy is made once, through the copy endpoint of Superset, with the layout and the settings of the source; afterwards it is a dashboard of its own, whose title, CSS and settings this resource manages, and the source can change without affecting it. The copy shows the same charts as the source, or, with `duplicate_slices`, duplicates of them that belong to the copy. Destroying the resource deletes the copy; duplicated charts stay.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_dashboard" "template" {
  slug = "sales-template"
}

# A copy that shows the same charts as the template.
resource "superset_dashboard_copy" "emea" {
  source_dashboard_id = data.superset_dashboard.template.id
  title               = "Sales EMEA"
  css                 = ".dashboard-header { background: #004c6d; }"
  json_metadata = jsonencode({
    color_scheme = "supersetColors"
  })
}

# A copy with its own charts, duplicated from the template, which can be changed without
# touching the template.
resource "superset_dashboard_copy" "apac" {
  source_dashboard_id = data.superset_dashboard.template.id
  title               = "Sales APAC"
  duplicate_slices    = true
}

output "apac_chart_ids" {
  value = superset_dashboard_copy.apac.chart_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_dashboard_id` (Number) Identifier of the dashboard to copy. A change makes a new copy.
- `title` (String) Title of the copy.

### Optional

- `css` (String) CSS applied to the copy. The CSS of the source is not copied.
- `duplicate_slices` (Boolean) Whether to duplicate the charts of the source, so the copy shows charts of its own that can be changed without touching the source. Defaults to `false`: the copy shows the charts of the source. A change makes a new copy.
- `json_metadata` (String) JSON document with the settings of the copy, such as `refresh_frequency` or `color_scheme`, over the settings of the source. Only the keys set here are managed: keys Superset adds or that are changed in the UI keep their value and are not reported as drift. When unset, the settings of the source are kept.

### Read-Only

- `chart_ids` (List of Number) Identifiers of the charts shown on the copy: the charts of the source, or their duplicates.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the copy.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the copy, as export bundles and the embedded SDK reference it (null on Superset 3.1, which does not return it).
